Centiskorch

Fire Bug

Galar · Generation 8

Centiskorch is a Fire/Bug-type Radiator Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 3 m tall and weighs 120 kg. It evolves from Sizzlipede. Its highest base stat is Attack (115), with a base stat total of 525.
